hints.title: A tree has a precise edge count
hints.body: Any tree on `n` nodes has exactly `n - 1` edges. If the input has a different number, it cannot be a tree.

hints.title: Edge count is not enough
hints.body: A graph with `n - 1` edges can still be disconnected if it contains a cycle in one component and leaves another component isolated.

hints.title: Union and detect cycles
hints.body: Process edges with a disjoint-set structure. If an edge joins two nodes already in the same component, it creates a cycle. A self-loop also joins a node to itself.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if edges.length != n - 1: return false

parent = [0, 1, ..., n - 1]

find(x):
    while parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
        x = parent[x]
    return x

for (u, v) in edges:
    root_u = find(u)
    root_v = find(v)
    if root_u == root_v: return false
    union(root_u, root_v)

return true
```
